sn35.133:1.2: It is unusual, if not unique, to see a female brahmin with a student. Below she is referred to as the “tutor’s wife” (_ācariyabhariyā_). Since the tutor is absent, perhaps she is his widow, who took on the role of teacher with his passing. At Chāndogya Upaniṣad 4.10 we see the tutor’s wife (_ācāryajāyā_) discussing the education of the pupil.
